title: agrostis hyemalis var. scabra
intro: Agrostis hyemalis var. scabra, commonly known as rough bent grass, is a variety of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of rough bent grass include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, helping to relieve respiratory congestion, and its anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
